author: haiku
label: climb-02-01
changes: Start: stated how state, nonce and PKCE verifier are generated, where each goes, and that the raw state is never stored.
Callback: stated the order of checks; cookie check now comes first and compares the state parameter with the cookie; the cookie is cleared once that check passes.
Failure table: split cookie-mismatch (nothing changes) from unknown/expired/used state with a matching cookie (cookie cleared).
Settings: the attempt stores the settings session id (not user id); the callback checks the sid cookie matches it and the session is unexpired.
Start: validated next as a relative path at start; start_session re-checks it.
New users: removed the 'Race: re-read once' loop. A unique clash rolls back and shows the error page; a retry takes the normal path.
Password confirmation: form posts password only; user and sub come from the pending record; noted why NULL-hash users never reach the password check.
Unlink: one DELETE statement with the password_hash IS NOT NULL condition, written out.
Errors: return target is fixed by mode; messages are fixed codes, not URL text.
Merged the duplicate notes (tokens, Google-only accounts, lookups) and the duplicated Redis-unavailable lines into one place each.
Dropped the separate 'Session valid' wording in favour of the sid-equals-session check.
Kept the three Decisions to confirm unchanged in substance; no new mechanisms added (no lock, lease, retry queue or takeover).
Callback order (4): stated that the code exchange is one HTTP call with a fixed timeout set in code, and that a timeout counts as a failure.

Password confirmation: stated that the goauth_pending cookie is cleared with its record, and gave the reason for the password step (an email match does not prove the existing account belongs to this person).
Added a Failed logins note: only the password step changes failed_logins; a linked Google sign-in leaves it alone and a new user starts at 0.
Settings session check: said that if the session is gone at callback, the user lands on login with a neutral message, nothing is linked, and they can start again from settings.
start_session note: said that it replaces any session the browser holds, including one for a different user.
State table, pending link row: said the goauth_pending cookie is cleared with the record.
Merged the intro and the two-entry-point paragraph into one short opening paragraph, and dropped the repeated statement that both entry points share routes.

Merged the Start, Callback order and Where-errors-go notes into one Start note and one Callback order list. Removed the duplicated 'attempt consumed' and error-page wording, which the Failure outcomes table already states.

Removed the separate 'Redis unavailable' note and the separate 'Tokens' note's repetition of the table; Redis failure stays only in the Failure outcomes table, and the token and email rule stays as one short note.

Clarified 'Only the password step changes failed_logins' to 'In the Google flow, only the password step changes failed_logins', pointing to the POST /login change. This removes an apparent contradiction with that change. No behaviour changed.
Shortened the password-confirmation note and the settings session check, keeping the user-binding, cookie, lock-check, cleanup and reason-for-password points.
Renamed 'Decisions to confirm' to 'Open questions' and kept all three together at the end. Question text is unchanged.
Kept the Mermaid flowchart unchanged. It already covers both entry points, every callback outcome, the password loop and the failed code exchange, and cutting any node would drop a required path.

Kept the state-location table and the failure-outcomes table in full, since the brief requires both. Tightened only the Session and Pending-link lifetime wording, without changing what removes each item.
